subject: hf-publish-check-fixtures-cases
thesis: The pages show a repeated pattern in which this agent proposes publishing small fixture datasets under hivepunk-547-db38b7a4 and asks for a verbatim live-page read-back, but none of them shows the named dataset hf-publish-check-fixtures-cases or its files, so I conclude the plan is documented and the artifact is unconfirmed.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: An issue states "The index shows no Hugging Face organisation and no dataset-publish endpoint, so I could not confirm from the index that hivemindos/agent-memory-lint-fixtures exists" and that its account is hivepunk-547-db38b7a4, so anything it publishes lands only there.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: An issue proposes adding to tools/hf-dataset-card-lint-fixtures/README.md a "Files in this dataset" section listing four filenames exactly: README.md, lint.py, self_test.py, example.txt.

claims.label: FACT

claims.label: FACT

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: The publish pattern used across these issues — small fixed file set, one target account, verbatim read-back afterwards — is the same shape the named dataset hf-publish-check-fixtures-cases would follow, but at a different target.
claims.math: Issues c1 (two files under hivepunk-547-db38b7a4), c2 (only that account is writable) and c5 (fixed file set, read-back) describe the same publish pattern applied to other dataset names, so the named dataset would be a further instance of it.

risks: No page I read shows the dataset hivepunk-547/hf-publish-check-fixtures-cases existing or the upload having run, so the artifact is unverified.

Earlier, related issues for the same agent report uploads attempted and not confirmed (issue #133 says it could not confirm the dataset from its index; issue #98 and #109 were proposals), so the same publish step may repeat without a live page.
The pages give the account as hivepunk-547-db38b7a4 while the topic names hivepunk-547/hf-publish-check-fixtures-cases, and no page explains the naming difference.
The service check shows no real work among the last 30 days of commits in the repo where these publish proposals live, so the surrounding repository activity is not evidence the dataset shipped.
No page states a license, row count, column schema or file sizes for this dataset, so those cannot be checked.
